traditions.KJV: [ A Psalm ] of David .

1.english_reference: The LORD [ is ] my light and my salvation ;

traditions.WLC: יְהוָ֤ה אוֹרִ֣ י וְ֭ יִשְׁעִ י
traditions.LXX: Κύριος φωτισμός μου καὶ σωτήρ μου ,
traditions.VUL: Dóminus illuminátio mea , et salus mea ,
traditions.KJV: The LORD [ is ] my light and my salvation ;
whom shall I fear ?

1.english_reference: the LORD [ is ] the strength of my life ;

traditions.KJV: the LORD [ is ] the strength of my life ;

1.english_reference: of whom shall I be afraid ?

traditions.KJV: of whom shall I be afraid ?

2.english_reference: When the wicked , [ even ] mine enemies and my foes , came upon me to eat up my flesh

traditions.WLC: בִּ קְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨ י מְרֵעִים֮ לֶ אֱכֹ֪ל אֶת בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥ י צָרַ֣ י וְ אֹיְבַ֣ י לִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ κακοῦντας τοῦ φαγεῖν τὰς σάρκας μου , οἱ θλίβοντές με καὶ οἱ ἐχθροί μου
traditions.VUL: Dum apprópiant super me nocéntes , ut edant carnes meas : qui tríbulant me inimíci mei ,
traditions.KJV: When the wicked , [ even ] mine enemies and my foes , came upon me to eat up my flesh ,
they stumbled and fell .

3.english_reference: Though an host should encamp against me

traditions.KJV: Though an host should encamp against me ,
my heart shall not fear :

3.english_reference: though war should rise against me

traditions.KJV: though war should rise against me ,

3.english_reference: in this [ will ] I [ be ] confident .

traditions.KJV: in this [ will ] I [ be ] confident .

4.english_reference: One [ thing ] have I desired of the LORD

traditions.KJV: One [ thing ] have I desired of the LORD ,
that will I seek after ;

4.english_reference: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life

traditions.WLC: שִׁבְתִּ֣ י בְּ בֵית יְ֭הוָה כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑ י
traditions.LXX: τοῦ κατοικεῖν με ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου ,
traditions.VUL: ut inhábitem in domo Dómini ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ :
traditions.KJV: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life ,

4.english_reference: to behold the beauty of the LORD

traditions.LXX: τοῦ θεωρεῖν με τὴν τερπνότητα τοῦ κυρίου
traditions.KJV: to behold the beauty of the LORD ,

4.english_reference: and to inquire in his temple .

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ בַקֵּ֥ר בְּ הֵיכָלֽ וֹ
traditions.KJV: and to inquire in his temple .

5.english_reference: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨ נִי בְּ סֻכֹּ ה֮ בְּ י֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔκρυψέν με ἐν σκηνῇ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακῶν μου ;
traditions.VUL: Quóniam abscóndit me in tabernáculo suo : in die malórum
traditions.KJV: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion :

5.english_reference: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me ;

traditions.WLC: יַ֭סְתִּרֵ נִי בְּ סֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἐσκέπασέν με ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: protéxit me in abscóndito tabernáculi sui .
traditions.KJV: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me ;

5.english_reference: he shall set me up upon a rock .

traditions.KJV: he shall set me up upon a rock .

6.english_reference: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡ י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬ י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ὕψωσεν τὴν κεφαλήν μου ἐπ᾽ ἐχθρούς μου ;
traditions.VUL: In petra exaltávit me : et nunc exaltávit caput meum super inimícos meos .
traditions.KJV: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me :

6.english_reference: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭ אָהֳל וֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἐκύκλωσα καὶ ἔθυσα ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ αὐτοῦ θυσίαν ἀλαλαγμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Circuívi , et immolávi in tabernáculo eius hóstiam vociferatiónis :
traditions.KJV: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy ;
I will sing ,

6.english_reference: yea , I will sing praises unto the LORD .

traditions.KJV: yea , I will sing praises unto the LORD .

7.english_reference: Hear , O LORD , [ when ] I cry with my voice

traditions.LXX: εἰσάκουσον , Κύριε , τῆς φωνῆς μου ἧς ἐκέκραξα ;
traditions.VUL: Exáudi Dómine vocem meam , qua clamávi ad te :
traditions.KJV: Hear , O LORD , [ when ] I cry with my voice :
have mercy also upon me ,
and answer me .

9.english_reference: Hide not thy face [ far ] from me

traditions.WLC: אַל תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨י ךָ מִמֶּ נִּי֮
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Ne avértas fáciem tuam a me :
traditions.KJV: Hide not thy face [ far ] from me ;

9.english_reference: put not thy servant away in anger

traditions.WLC: אַֽל תַּט בְּ אַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ ךָ
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἐκκλίνῃς ἐν ὀργῇ ἀπὸ τοῦ δούλου σου ;
traditions.VUL: ne declínes in ira a servo tuo .
traditions.KJV: put not thy servant away in anger :
thou hast been my help ;
leave me not ,
neither forsake me ,
O God of my salvation .

10.english_reference: When my father and my mother forsake me

traditions.WLC: כִּי אָבִ֣ י וְ אִמִּ֣ י עֲזָב֑וּ נִי
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ ἡ μήτηρ μου ἐγκατέλιπόν με ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam pater meus et mater mea dereliquérunt me :
traditions.KJV: When my father and my mother forsake me ,

10.english_reference: then the LORD will take me up .

traditions.KJV: then the LORD will take me up .

11.english_reference: Teach me thy way , O LORD

traditions.LXX: νομοθέτησόν με , Κύριε , τῇ ὁδῷ σου ,
traditions.VUL: Legem pone mihi Dómine in via tua :
traditions.KJV: Teach me thy way , O LORD ,

11.english_reference: and lead me in a plain path

traditions.WLC: וּ֭ נְחֵ נִי בְּ אֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁδήγησόν με ἐν τρίβῳ ευθείᾳ
traditions.VUL: et dírige me in sémitam rectam
traditions.KJV: and lead me in a plain path ,
because of mine enemies .

12.english_reference: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies

traditions.WLC: אַֽל תִּ֭תְּנֵ נִי בְּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: μὴ παрадῷς με εἰς ψυχὰς θλιβόντων με ,
traditions.VUL: Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me :
traditions.KJV: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies :

12.english_reference: for false witnesses are risen up against me

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ בִ֥ י עֵֽדֵי שֶׁ֝֗קֶר
traditions.VUL: quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui ,
traditions.KJV: for false witnesses are risen up against me ,

12.english_reference: and such as breathe out cruelty

traditions.KJV: and such as breathe out cruelty .
Wait on the LORD :
be of good courage ,

14.english_reference: and he shall strengthen thine heart

traditions.KJV: and he shall strengthen thine heart :

14.english_reference: wait , I say , on the LORD

traditions.KJV: wait , I say , on the LORD .
